meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后,容器代理可通过 MCP 调用本地 Ollama 模型,Claude 仍是总指挥,可把任务交给本地模型。默认提供列出模型、生成回复两个工具;开启管理选项后,还能拉取、删除、查看模型等。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 Ollama 处理任务、让 Claude 调用本地模型,或询问本地有哪些模型时触发。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都是什么
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型,再用合适的模型生成回答。

say.text: 列出当前已安装的 Ollama 模型
say.note: 会调用列表工具,返回模型名称、大小等信息。

say.text: 帮我拉取 gemma3:1b 模型
say.note: 若已启用管理工具,会执行拉取下载。

howto.what_en: After installation, the agent can call local Ollama models via MCP. Claude stays the orchestrator and can hand work to local models. Default tools: list models and generate. With the admin flag: pull, delete, inspect models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use Ollama for a task, wants Claude to call a local model, or asks which local models are available.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models, picks one, and generates the answer.

say_en.text: List the currently installed Ollama models.
say_en.note: Calls the list tool, returning names, sizes, and families.

say_en.text: Pull the gemma3:1b model for me.
say_en.note: Executes the pull if admin tools are enabled.
